# automorphism group　`def.automorphism-group`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.automorphism-group)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.automorphism-group.md)

## Notes · **draft**
⭐ Examples: $\operatorname{Aut}(\mathbb{Z}/n) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/n)^{\times}$; $\operatorname{Aut}(V_4) \cong S_3$; for $n \ne 6$, $\operatorname{Aut}(S_n) = \operatorname{Inn}(S_n) \cong S_n$.

⚠ $n = 6$ is the exception: $S_6$ has outer automorphisms, and $\operatorname{Out}(S_6)$ has order $2$.

⭐ The kernel of the inner action is the center $Z(G)$: $c_g = \mathrm{id} \iff g \in Z(G)$, which is exactly the source of $G/Z(G) \cong \operatorname{Inn}(G)$.
